_comment: How to build an RTSP path for each family of recorder.
Two facts per brand, not one. `path_template` is the shape; `main` and
`sub` are the integers that brand uses to mean full-resolution and
reduced-resolution. They differ between vendors, so a template alone
would leave whoever adds a recorder supplying the number from memory.
Data, not code: supporting another device is an edit here. Placeholders
are {channel} (1-based, as every device here numbers them) and {subtype}.
